full_name: Gigliola Staffilani | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Mathematics Elizabeth S. and Richard M. Cashin Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Gigliola Staffilani, the Abby Rockefeller Mauzé Professor of Mathematics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, is interested in the study of partial differential equations (PDE) of the dispersive type.
